actions.description: It will adjust screen orientation settings

steps: Using two fingers, swipe down from the top of the screen to open the Quick settings panel.

actions.description: It will test app rotation

steps: Open an app and try rotating your screen by turning your device sideways.
Avoid touching the screen while rotating the device, as this can interfere with the rotation process.

actions.description: It will contact customer support

actions.description: It will restart your device

steps: On devices with a Power button, press and hold the Power button.

Tap Restart again to confirm.

Tap the Power icon.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.

actions.description: It will open factory data reset settings

steps: If the previous steps did not resolve the screen rotation issue, perform a factory data reset.

Search for and select Factory data reset.
Tap Factory data reset again.
Review the information presented.
Tap Reset.
Tap Delete all.
Enter your TechCorp account password.
